announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the AGM results follow recent board changes and the launch of the Covenant Platform.

announcements.headline: Launch of Covenant Platform
announcements.insight: Following recent board changes and half-year results, this announcement introduces a new platform. Shareholders should monitor for further details on its strategic relevance.

announcements.headline: Unaudited Half-Year Results Ending 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Technologies New Energies plc published half-year results. This follows June share option awards and September board changes.

announcements.headline: Board and Committee Changes
announcements.insight: Technologies New Energies plc announces board changes following a June share option award. Shareholders should monitor for further governance updates.

announcements.headline: Share Option Award and PDMR Notification
announcements.insight: Technologies New Energies plc has filed a PDMR notification regarding share options. This is the first such filing on record for the company.
